messages:
sophie: noticing a sharp p95/p99 jump on hosted API ~13:02 UTC, looks isolated to region-us-west-2 :thinking_face:
amar: seeing same in dashboards — queue depth up and a handful of tenants show large backlog. p95 from 180ms -> 900ms, p99 -> 2.4s
ben: any recent kernel or batching rollout?
sophie: rolled batching heuristics + prefetch ramp yesterday 22:40 PT (canary -> global)
zara: grabbing flamegraphs + kv-cache metrics now. infra-bot: started perf profile job 1951234600 (collecting 60s)
ben: quick check: are we seeing kernel fallback churn? that would blow up latency for long-seq requests
amar: profiler snippet coming: ```
# top call stacks aggregated (sampled)
- infer_loop -> kv_cache_get (45%)
- kv_cache_get -> prefetch_lock_wait (28%)
- infer_loop -> kernel_dispatch_fallback (18%)
- batching_coordinator -> wait_on_batch (9%)
```
sophie: kv_cache_get waiting on prefetch_lock_wait — interesting. hit-rate dropped for tenant T-42 around spike, lots of long sequences
zara: kv cache metrics: tenant T-42 miss rate jumped 12% -> 62% at 13:02. kv cache eviction spikes aligned. Also prefetch request rate for same tenant increased x3
ben: sounds like a tenant-generated hot keyset causing prefetch contention + locks held while kernel fallback serializes execution
amar: I can reproduce locally by blasting long-seq requests for tenant T-42 and forcing a kernel fallback path (quantized->fp32). prefetch lock spikes and batches delay
sophie: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) throttle tenant burst for prefetch-heavy requests, 2) route T-42 to dedicated pool, 3) roll back prefetch ramp globally
zara: infra-bot ran an autoscale snapshot: GPU utilization normal, but per-instance queue depth uneven — noisy tenant concentrated on 3 nodes
ben: we should increase per-tenant batch cap and add prefetch parallelism to avoid single-lock bottleneck. Also add a fast-path kernel selection avoiding fallback for sequences < 1024 tokens until we validate ramp
sophie: doing immediate actions: 1) applied tenant burst throttle for T-42 (rate cap 30rps) at 13:18 UTC, 2) pinned T-42 routing to dedicated-ephemeral pool at 13:21 UTC
amar: after throttle, p95 dropped from 900ms -> 220ms within 90s. p99 back to ~600ms. queue depth normalized.
zara: creating follow-up tickets: PERF-4921 (prefetch lock redesign), PERF-4922 (per-tenant batch/cap enforcement), RUNTIME-5103 (kernel selection safety net).
sophie: leave prefetch ramp rolled back to canary for now. assign owners and add alert on kv_cache lock wait ratio > 15%
ben: note for postmortem: tenant isolation case — workload patterns (many long seqs + model variant) + prefetch ramp caused lock amplification + kernel fallback slowed batches -> noisy neighbor effect
infra-bot: created incident ticket #INC-8217 and paged oncall@redwood (snoozed)
sophie: thanks everyone. will sync in 30m for RCA and prioritization :thumbsup:
